@@ -0,0 +1,464 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
+#
+# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
+# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
+# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
+#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
+#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
+#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
+#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
+#
+# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
+#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
+#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
+#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
+#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
+#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
+#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
+#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
+#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
+#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
+#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
+#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
+#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
+#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
+#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
+#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
+#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
+#
+# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
+#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
+#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
+#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
+#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
+#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
+#
+# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
+#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
+#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
+#
+# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
+# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
+# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
+CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
+DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
+CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
+# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
+# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
+SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
+
+SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
+CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
+DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
+
+usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
+die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
+    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
+    --help|-h) usage ;;
+    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
+case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
+[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
+[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
+[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
+[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
+[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
+for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
+
+SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
+[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
+TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
+
+IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
+IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
+[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
+[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
+for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
+  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
+  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
+    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
+done
+for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
+  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
+  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
+  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
+  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
+  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
+        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
+    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
+  fi
+done
+
+SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
+  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
+SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
+WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
+
+[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
+[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
+SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
+BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
+
+# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
+# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
+# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
+verify_corpus() {
+  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
+import hashlib, os, sys
+corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
+raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
+bad = []
+for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
+    if not line.strip():
+        continue
+    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
+    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
+                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
+        continue
+    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
+    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
+        bad.append(rel)
+if bad:
+    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(1)
+print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
+PY
+}
+CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
+
+# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
+PLAN=()
+for t in $(seq 1 "$TRIALS"); do
+  for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
+    for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do PLAN+=("$a|$f|$t"); done
+  done
+done
+
+json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }
+
+write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
+  local out="$1" dry="$2" claude_bin="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" cli_version
+  cli_version="$("$claude_bin" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unknown)"
+  local harness_commit harness_dirty=false
+  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
+  [[ -n "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain -- evals/harness evals/graders evals/suites evals/tasks 2>/dev/null)" ]] && harness_dirty=true
+  local per_trial
+  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-${FIXTURES[0]}.yaml")"
+  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
+  jq -n \
+    --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg batch "$BATCH" \
+    --arg source_commit "$SRC_FULL" --arg source_worktree "$WORKTREE" \
+    --arg harness_commit "$harness_commit" --argjson harness_dirty "$harness_dirty" \
+    --arg model_id "$MODEL" --arg cli "$claude_bin" --arg cli_version "$cli_version" \
+    --argjson trials "$TRIALS" --argjson concurrency "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson retry_wait "$RETRY_WAIT" \
+    --argjson per_trial "$per_trial" --arg max_turns "${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}" \
+    --argjson arms "$(json_array "${ARMS[@]}")" --argjson fixtures "$(json_array "${FIXTURES[@]}")" \
+    --argjson planned "${#PLAN[@]}" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" \
+    --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
+    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \
+    --arg py_v "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg git_v "$(git --version 2>/dev/null)" \
+    --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson dry "$dry" \
+    --arg suite_file "evals/suites/$SUITE.yaml" \
+    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, dry_run: $dry, created: $created,
+      source_commit: $source_commit, source_worktree: $source_worktree,
+      harness_commit: $harness_commit, harness_dirty: $harness_dirty, suite_file: $suite_file,
+      model_id: $model_id,
+      executor: {cli: $cli, cli_version: $cli_version, tools: "Read,Grep,Glob,Write", restricted: true,
+                 permission_mode: "acceptEdits", max_turns: ($max_turns | tonumber), effort: "task/skill default",
+                 timeout_per_trial_s: $per_trial, concurrency: $concurrency, retry: {transport_retries: 1, wait_s: $retry_wait},
+                 subagent_model: "pinned to model_id (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL); parent-session coupling unset",
+                 seed: null},
+      arms: $arms, fixtures: $fixtures, trials: $trials, trials_planned: $planned,
+      corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: $digest,
+               verified: "every entry before the batch; the fixture'"'"'s entries before each trial"},
+      environment: {os: $os, bash: $bash_v, jq: $jq_v, yq: $yq_v, python: $py_v, git: $git_v}}' > "$out.tmp"
+  mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
+}
+
+if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then
+  mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json"
+  [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" ]] && mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.dry-run.json"
+  write_manifest "$mpath" true
+  echo "run-arms (dry run): suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL worktree=$WORKTREE"
+  echo "planned trials: ${#PLAN[@]} (${#FIXTURES[@]} fixtures x ${#ARMS[@]} arms x $TRIALS trials, concurrency $CONCURRENCY)"
+  i=0
+  for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
+    i=$((i + 1)); IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
+    printf '%4d  %-16s %-6s trial %s  task %s-%s\n' "$i" "$a" "$f" "$t" "$TASK_PREFIX" "$f"
+  done
+  echo "manifest: $mpath"
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
+command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || die "executor CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN"
+
+# --- the pinned source worktree -------------------------------------------------
+mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT"
+if [[ -e "$WORKTREE" ]]; then
+  [[ "$(git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" == "$SRC_FULL" ]] \
+    || die "$WORKTREE exists but is not at $SRC_FULL; remove it with git worktree remove"
+  [[ -z "$(git -C "$WORKTREE" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]] \
+    || die "$WORKTREE has local changes; the pinned source must be pristine"
+else
+  git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" worktree add --detach "$WORKTREE" "$SRC_FULL" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
+    || die "could not create the source worktree at $WORKTREE"
+fi
+
+# --- batch directory and lock --------------------------------------------------
+mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR"
+LOCK="$BATCH_DIR/.lock"
+mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || die "batch $BATCH is locked ($LOCK): another run-arms is using it"
+JOBS_DIR="$BATCH_DIR/.jobs"
+mkdir -p "$JOBS_DIR"
+cleanup() {
+  local p
+  for p in $(jobs -p 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
+  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+if [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" ]] && [[ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")" == "false" ]]; then
+  prev_src="$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")"
+  prev_model="$(jq -r '.model_id' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")"
+  [[ "$prev_src" == "$SRC_FULL" && "$prev_model" == "$MODEL" ]] \
+    || die "batch $BATCH already holds results for source $prev_src / model $prev_model; use another --batch"
+fi
+write_manifest "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" false
+LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
+log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; }
+
+STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+STATE="running"
+# per-arm counters (indexed arrays parallel to ARMS — bash 3.2 has no maps)
+DONE=() FAILED=() PLANNED=()
+for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do DONE[$i]=0; FAILED[$i]=0; PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${#FIXTURES[@]} * TRIALS )); done
+arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
+
+write_status() {
+  local per='{}' i finished=null
+  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
+    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson d "${DONE[$i]}" --argjson f "${FAILED[$i]}" --argjson p "${PLANNED[$i]}" \
+      '. + {($a): {trials_done: $d, trials_failed: $f, trials_planned: $p}}' <<<"$per")"
+  done
+  [[ "$STATE" != "running" ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
+  jq -n --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model "$MODEL" \
+    --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" \
+    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
+      source_commit: $src, model_id: $model, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
+  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
+  aggregate_status
+}
+
+# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
+# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
+aggregate_status() {
+  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
+  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
+  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
+  jq -s --arg suite "$SUITE" '
+    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
+    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
+    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
+     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
+     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
+        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
+                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
+                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
+     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
+     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
+     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
+    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \
+    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"
+  rmdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
+
+# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
+is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
+  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
+  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
+  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
+  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
+  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|network|socket hang up|5[0-9][0-9] ' \
+    "$err" "$out" 2>/dev/null && return 0
+  return 1
+}
+
+run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
+  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
+  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
+  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
+  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
+  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
+  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
+  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
+  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
+    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
+  fi
+  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
+    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
+    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
+    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
+      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
+    ex_rc=0
+    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
+      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
+      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
+        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
+        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
+    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
+    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
+      local gout gexit=0
+      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
+        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
+      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
+        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
+      fi
+      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
+      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
+      break
+    fi
+    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
+      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
+      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
+        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
+        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        ws=""; executor='null'
+        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
+      fi
+    else
+      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
+    fi
+    break
+  done
+  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
+  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then
+    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""
+    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
+    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
+    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
+    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
+    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
+    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
+    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
+      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
+      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
+      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
+      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
+     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
+  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
+}
+
+keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
+  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
+  mkdir -p "$dest"
+  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
+    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
+  done
+  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
+  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
+  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
+collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
+  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
+  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
+  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
+    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
+    set_state failed; exit 3
+  fi
+  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
+    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
+    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
+      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
+      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
+    else
+      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
+      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
+    fi
+    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
+  else
+    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
+    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
+  fi
+  write_status
+}
+
+log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
+write_status
+trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
+
+PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
+reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
+  local i
+  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
+    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
+      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
+        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
+        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
+        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
+        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
+        break
+      fi
+    done
+    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
+  done
+  return 0
+}
+
+n=0
+for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
+  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
+  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
+  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
+  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
+  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
+done
+reap 1
+
+total_done=0 total_failed=0
+for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
+if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
+  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
+elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
+  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
+else
+  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
+fi

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
+
+Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
+suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
+<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
+`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
+
+Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
+the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
+findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
+findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
+bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
+the verdict and the missed labels.
+
+Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
+  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
+                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
+                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
+                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
+                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
+  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
+                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
+  no recall loss  every rule holds:
+                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
+                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
+                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
+An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
+
+Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
+given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+
+
+def load_yaml_subset(path):
+    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
+    import subprocess
+    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    return json.loads(out)
+
+
+def read_jsonl(path):
+    rows = []
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        return rows
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line:
+                try:
+                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
+                except ValueError:
+                    continue
+    return rows
+
+
+def mean(xs):
+    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
+    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
+
+
+def fmt(x, nd=3):
+    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
+
+
+def recall_details(row):
+    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
+        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
+            return g["details"]
+    return None
+

+    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
+    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
+    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
+    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
+    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
+
+    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
+    arms = {}
+    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
+        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
+        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
+        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
+            continue
+        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
+        if m.get("dry_run"):
+            continue
+        manifests.append(m)
+        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
+        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
+            if a not in planned_arms:
+                planned_arms.append(a)
+            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
+            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
+                arm.add(row)
+    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
+    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
+    complete = state == "complete"
+
+    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
+    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
+    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
+    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
+    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
+    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
+                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
+                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+
+    base = arms.get("baseline")
+    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
+    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
+    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
+    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
+    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
+
+    def coverage_gaps(arm):
+        gaps = []
+        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
+            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
+            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
+            if planted == 0:
+                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
+            if n < trials_required:
+                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
+        return gaps
+
+    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
+              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
+    out_lines.append(header)
+    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
+    details = []
+    verdicts = {}
+    for a in order:
+        arm = arms[a]
+        fm = arm.fixture_means()
+        tm = arm.trial_means()
+        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
+        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
+        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
+        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
+        rs = arm.refuted_share()
+        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
+        drop = lo = hi = None
+        reasons = []
+        if a == "baseline":
+            verdict = "(reference)"
+        else:
+            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
+            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
+            drop = mean(deltas)
+            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
+            if partial:
+                reasons.append("--partial report")
+            if not complete:
+                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
+            if base is None:
+                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
+            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
+            if gaps:
+                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
+            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
+            if len(mods) > 1:
+                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
+            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
+            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
+                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
+            if not deltas:
+                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
+            if reasons:
+                verdict = "inconclusive"
+            else:
+                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
+                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
+                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
+                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
+                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
+                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
+                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
+                    refuted_violated = True
+                if not violated:
+                    verdict = "no recall loss"
+                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
+                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
+                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
+                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
+                    verdict = "inconclusive"
+                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
+                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
+                else:
+                    verdict = "recall loss"
+                    reasons.extend(violated)
+            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
+                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
+        verdicts[a] = verdict
+        out_lines.append(
+            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
+            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
+            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
+        if arm.fallback_trials:
+            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
+                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
+        if reasons:
+            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
+        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
+            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
+            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    if details:
+        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
+        out_lines.extend(details)
+        out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    for a in order:
+        arm = arms[a]
+        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
+        if not items:
+            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
+            continue
+        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
+        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
+        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    return state, verdicts
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
+    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
+        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
+    if not suites:
+        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    for s in suites:
+        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
+            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 2
+        st = {}
+        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
+        if os.path.isfile(sp):
+            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
+        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
+            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
+                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
+                  file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+
+    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
+    if args.partial:
+        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
+                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
+    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
+              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
+              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
+              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
+    for s in suites:
+        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
+    print(args.out)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
+# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
+# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
+#
+# Usage:
+#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
+#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]
+#                              [--feedback a.md,b.md] [--dry-run]
+#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --build-manifest pr-NN   # labels → hidden manifest (after curation)
+#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <YYYY-MM-DD>"
+#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --freeze                 # regenerate SHA256SUMS
+#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check                  # verify SHA256SUMS
+#   common: [--repo <git dir>] [--corpus <evals/fixtures/review-prs>]
+#
+# Without --base/--head/--fix/--feedback/--out the sprint's row in
+# <corpus>/record-pairs.tsv supplies them.
+#
+# Writes (seed):
+#   <corpus>/pr-NN/{fixture.yaml, head.diff, PR.md, REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md,
+#                   AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, base/…, head/…}     (copied into the sandbox)
+#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.tsv          HIDDEN (never copied into a sandbox): the labels,
+#                                      first line `# approved-by: pending`
+#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt  HIDDEN: every finding that did not become a label, and why
+#   <corpus>/manifests/pr-NN.json      HIDDEN: the graded manifest (`approved: false` until --approve)
+#   <corpus>/corpus.tsv                one `record` row per fixture (or a `#` gap comment)
+#   evals/tasks/{review,audit}-recall/{review,audit}-pr-NN.yaml
+#   <corpus>/SHA256SUMS                refreshed
+#
+# Scope: the fixture is the change base..head without the generated or state
+# files (grimoires/, CHANGELOG.md, .claude/checksums.json, REPO-MAP.md, lock
+# files, .beads/, .run/, evals/results/) and without binaries.
+#
+# Label rule: a feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit
+# touches the file it cites (`git diff --name-only head..fix`) and that file
+# is part of the fixture; label_source is review (engineer-feedback*,
+# reviewer*), audit (auditor-sprint-feedback*) or bridgebuilder
+# (bridgebuilder*, the "Fixed" table only). The anchor is a head-side line
+# the fix changed near the cited line or inside the cited symbol; a finding
+# that cites only a file is anchored on that file's fix hunks when there are
+# at most four, else dropped. `fix` rows cover every hunk fix_commit changed
+# in a fixture file (source fix/<sha>:<start>-<end>); the grader uses them
+# only for refuted share. Titles are control-stripped, capped at 160 chars,
+# and a title matching a secret pattern drops its finding; every written
+# file passes evals/graders/no-secrets.sh or the seed fails.
+#
+# Exit: 0 ok, 1 refused / spec error / secret found / check failed, 2 usage
+# Tested by evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats.
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+
+exec python3 -I - "$REPO_ROOT" "$@" <<'PY'
+import argparse, csv, hashlib, io, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
+
+HARNESS_ROOT = sys.argv[1]
+argv = sys.argv[2:]
+
+ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="seed-corpus-from-record.sh", add_help=True)
+ap.add_argument("sprint", nargs="?")
+ap.add_argument("record_ref", nargs="?")
+ap.add_argument("--out"); ap.add_argument("--base"); ap.add_argument("--head"); ap.add_argument("--fix")
+ap.add_argument("--feedback"); ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
+ap.add_argument("--build-manifest", metavar="FIXTURE"); ap.add_argument("--approve", metavar="FIXTURE")
+ap.add_argument("--by"); ap.add_argument("--freeze", action="store_true"); ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
+ap.add_argument("--repo", default=HARNESS_ROOT)
+ap.add_argument("--corpus", default=os.path.join(HARNESS_ROOT, "evals", "fixtures", "review-prs"))
+ap.add_argument("--tasks-dir", default=os.path.join(HARNESS_ROOT, "evals", "tasks"))
+try:
+    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
+except SystemExit as e:
+    sys.exit(2 if e.code else 0)
+
+REPO, CORPUS = os.path.abspath(args.repo), os.path.abspath(args.corpus)
+NO_SECRETS = os.path.join(HARNESS_ROOT, "evals", "graders", "no-secrets.sh")
+LABELS_DIR = os.path.join(CORPUS, "labels")
+MANIFESTS_DIR = os.path.join(CORPUS, "manifests")
+FX_RX = re.compile(r"^pr-[0-9]{2}$")
+HEADER = ["defect_id", "severity", "category", "file", "must_match", "label_source", "source"]
+
+def fail(msg, code=1):
+    print(f"seed-corpus: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(code)
+
+def git(*a, binary=False, check=True):
+    p = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, *a], capture_output=True, text=not binary)
+    if check and p.returncode != 0:
+        fail(f"git {' '.join(a[:3])} failed: {(p.stderr if not binary else p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')).strip()[:300]}")
+    return p.stdout
+
+def rev(r):
+    p = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", f"{r}^{{commit}}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    if p.returncode != 0:
+        fail(f"missing commit: {r}")
+    return p.stdout.strip()
+
+def show(r, path):
+    p = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPO, "show", f"{r}:{path}"], capture_output=True)
+    return p.stdout if p.returncode == 0 else None
+
+CTRL = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f  ]")
+def clean(s, cap=160):
+    s = CTRL.sub(" ", s)
+    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
+    return s if len(s) <= cap else s[: cap - 1].rstrip() + "…"
+
+SECRET_RX = [re.compile(p) for p in (
+    r"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}", r"sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}", r"ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}", r"gho_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}",
+    r"glpat-[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{20,}", r"xox[bpors]-[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+", r"sk-ant-[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{20,}",
+    r"password\s*[:=]\s*[\"'][^\"']{8,}", r"secret\s*[:=]\s*[\"'][^\"']{8,}")]
+def has_secret(s):
+    return any(r.search(s) for r in SECRET_RX)
+
+REDACTED = [0]
+def redact(b, count=True):
+    """Secret-shaped strings in verbatim copies of tracked files (fake test keys)
+    become a fixed marker, identically in base/, head/ and head.diff; line
+    numbers never move. Counted in the dropped report."""
+    if b is None:
+        return None
+    t = b.decode("utf-8", "replace") if isinstance(b, bytes) else b
+    for r in SECRET_RX:
+        t, n = r.subn("REDACTED-TEST-SECRET", t)
+        REDACTED[0] += n if count else 0
+    return t.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(b, bytes) else t
+
+def sha(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
+
+def freeze():
+    entries = []
+    for root, _d, files in os.walk(CORPUS):
+        for f in files:
+            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), CORPUS)
+            if rel != "SHA256SUMS":
+                entries.append(rel)
+    lines = [f"{sha(os.path.join(CORPUS, rel))}  {rel}" for rel in sorted(entries)]
+    open(os.path.join(CORPUS, "SHA256SUMS"), "w").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
+    return len(lines)
+
+def check():
+    bad, n = [], 0
+    for line in open(os.path.join(CORPUS, "SHA256SUMS"), encoding="utf-8"):
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        n += 1
+        d, rel = line.rstrip("\n").split("  ", 1)
+        p = os.path.join(CORPUS, rel)
+        if not os.path.isfile(p) or sha(p) != d:
+            bad.append(rel)
+    listed = {l.rstrip("\n").split("  ", 1)[1] for l in open(os.path.join(CORPUS, "SHA256SUMS"), encoding="utf-8") if l.strip()}
+    for root, _d, files in os.walk(CORPUS):
+        for f in files:
+            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), CORPUS)
+            if rel != "SHA256SUMS" and rel not in listed:
+                bad.append(rel + " (not listed)")
+    if bad:
+        fail("SHA256SUMS mismatch: " + ", ".join(bad[:20]))
+    print(f"corpus OK: {n} files match SHA256SUMS")
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- labels I/O
+def read_labels(fx):
+    path = os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, f"{fx}.tsv")
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        fail(f"labels not found: {path}")
+    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
+    if not text or not re.match(r"^# approved-by: \S", text[0]):
+        fail(f"{path}: the first line must be '# approved-by: <who> <date>' (or 'pending')")
+    approved_by = text[0][len("# approved-by: "):].strip()
+    body = [l for l in text[1:] if l and not l.startswith("#")]
+    if not body or body[0].split("\t") != HEADER:
+        fail(f"{path}: header must be: " + "\t".join(HEADER))
+    rows = []
+    for i, l in enumerate(body[1:], 2):
+        cells = l.split("\t")
+        if len(cells) != len(HEADER):
+            fail(f"{path}: row {i} has {len(cells)} columns, want {len(HEADER)}")
+        rows.append(dict(zip(HEADER, cells)))
+    return approved_by, rows, text
+
+def unique_line(lines, needle):
+    hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines, 1) if needle in l]
+    return hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None
+
+def build_manifest(fx):
+    approved_by, rows, _ = read_labels(fx)
+    fyaml = os.path.join(CORPUS, fx, "fixture.yaml")
+    meta = {}
+    for l in open(fyaml, encoding="utf-8"):
+        m = re.match(r"^(sprint|head_commit|fix_commit|record_ref):\s*\"?([^\"\n]*)\"?$", l)
+        if m:
+            meta[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    defects, regions, errors, order = {}, [], [], []
+    for r in rows:
+        if r["label_source"] not in ("review", "audit", "bridgebuilder", "fix"):
+            errors.append(f"{r['defect_id']}: label_source {r['label_source']!r}"); continue
+        hp = os.path.join(CORPUS, fx, "head", r["file"])
+        if not os.path.isfile(hp):
+            errors.append(f"{r['defect_id']}: head/{r['file']} missing"); continue
+        lines = open(hp, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
+        if r["label_source"] == "fix":
+            m = re.match(r"^fix/[0-9a-f]+:(\d+)-(\d+)$", r["source"])
+            if not m:
+                errors.append(f"{r['defect_id']}: fix source must be fix/<sha>:<start>-<end>"); continue
+            regions.append({"id": r["defect_id"], "file": r["file"], "start": int(m.group(1)), "end": int(m.group(2)),
+                            "source": r["source"]})
+            continue

+            if not picked and rng[0] <= len(lines):
+                picked, how = [(rng[0], rng[1])], f"cited line {rng[0]} (no fix hunk within 60 lines)"
+        elif ext:
+            inside = [h for h in hs if ext[0] <= h[0] <= ext[1]]
+            picked, how = (inside[:2], f"fix hunk inside {sym}()") if inside else ([(ext[0], ext[0])], f"definition of {sym}")
+        if snip_anchors:
+            how = "quoted snippet" + (f" + {how}" if how else "")
+        elif picked and not hs_overlap(picked, hs) and not pr_changed(p, picked[0][0]):
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] pre-existing site: neither the change nor the fix touched "
+                           f"{p}:{picked[0][0]}: {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        if not picked and not snip_anchors:
+            if 0 < len(hs) <= 4:
+                picked, how = hs, "the file's fix hunks (file-level finding)"
+            else:
+                dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] no locator ({len(hs)} fix hunks in {p}): {f['title']}")
+                continue
+        anchors = list(snip_anchors)
+        for lo, hi in picked[: (2 if snip_anchors else 3)]:
+            at, t = anchor_text(lines, lo, hi)
+            if at and t not in [x[1] for x in anchors] and at not in [x[0] for x in anchors]:
+                anchors.append((at, t))
+        # a short cited function: its definition line is a site too
+        if ext and ext[1] - ext[0] <= 40 and ext[0] not in [a for a, _ in anchors]:
+            at, t = anchor_text(lines, ext[0], ext[0])
+            if at == ext[0]:
+                anchors.append((at, t))
+        anchors = anchors[:4]
+        if not anchors:
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] no unique anchor line in head/{p}: {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        labels.append({"severity": f["severity"], "category": category(f["title"]), "file": p, "anchors": anchors,
+                       "label_source": source_kind(name), "source": src, "title": f["title"], "how": how})
+
+# dedupe: one label per (file, first anchor); the first source wins, sources noted
+seen, uniq = {}, []
+for lb in labels:
+    k = (lb["file"], lb["anchors"][0][0])
+    if k in seen:
+        dropped.append(f"{lb['source']} [{lb['severity']}] duplicate of {seen[k]['id']} (same anchor): {lb['title']}")
+        continue
+    lb["id"] = f"L{len(uniq) + 1:02d}-{slug(lb['title'])}"
+    seen[k] = lb; uniq.append(lb)
+labels = uniq
+
+# hand curation (labels/curation.tsv): re-applied on every seed
+cur_path = os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, "curation.tsv")
+if os.path.isfile(cur_path):
+    cur_lines = [l for l in open(cur_path, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("#")]
+    for c in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO("\n".join(cur_lines)), delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE):
+        if c["fixture"] != fx:
+            continue
+        hit = [lb for lb in labels if lb["id"].startswith(c["label"] + "-")]
+        if len(hit) != 1:
+            fail(f"curation.tsv: {fx} {c['label']} matches {len(hit)} seeded labels (re-check the row)")
+        lb = hit[0]
+        if c["action"] == "drop":
+            labels.remove(lb)
+            dropped.append(f"{lb['source']} [{lb['severity']}] curated out ({c['reason']}): {lb['title']}")
+        elif c["action"] == "anchors":
+            new = []
+            for needle in [s.strip() for s in c["value"].split(" ||| ") if s.strip()]:
+                at = unique_line(head_text[lb["file"]], needle)
+                if at is None:
+                    fail(f"curation.tsv: {fx} {c['label']} anchor {needle!r} is not on exactly one line of head/{lb['file']}")
+                new.append((at, needle))
+            lb["anchors"], lb["how"] = new, f"curated: {c['reason']}"
+        else:
+            fail(f"curation.tsv: unknown action {c['action']!r}")
+
+fix_rows = []
+for p in head_files:
+    for lo, hi in hunks.get(p, []):
+        at, t = anchor_text(head_text[p], lo, hi)
+        fix_rows.append({"id": f"F{len(fix_rows) + 1:03d}", "file": p, "must_match": t or "-",
+                         "source": f"fix/{fixc[:12]}:{lo}-{hi}"})
+
+# --- outputs ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+subjects = [s for s in git("log", "--reverse", "--format=%s", f"{base}..{head}").splitlines() if s]
+title = clean(subjects[0] if subjects else f"sprint-{sprint}", 200)
+pr_md = f"# {title}\n\n" + (f"Sprint {sprint} (global), {len(head_files)} file(s) in scope.\n"
+                             + ("\nCommits in this change:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"- {clean(s, 200)}" for s in subjects) + "\n" if len(subjects) > 1 else ""))
+tsv = [f"# approved-by: pending",
+       f"# fixture {fx} | sprint-{sprint} | record {record_ref} | base {base[:12]} | head {head[:12]} | fix {fixc[:12]}",
+       "# seeded by evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh; curate must_match (one row per anchor), then --approve",
+       *[f"# {lb['id'][:3]} {lb['severity']} {lb['label_source']}: {lb['title']} [{lb['how']}]" for lb in labels],
+       "\t".join(HEADER)]
+for lb in labels:
+    for at, t in lb["anchors"]:
+        tsv.append("\t".join([lb["id"], lb["severity"], lb["category"], lb["file"], t, lb["label_source"], lb["source"]]))
+for fr in fix_rows:
+    tsv.append("\t".join([fr["id"], "-", "fix", fr["file"], fr["must_match"], "fix", fr["source"]]))
+for row in tsv:
+    if "\t" in row and len(row.split("\t")) != len(HEADER):
+        fail(f"internal: malformed label row {row[:80]!r}")
+
+summary = (f"{fx} sprint-{sprint}: {len(head_files)} file(s), diff {len(diff_text)} B, "
+           f"{len(labels)} label(s) ({sum(len(l['anchors']) for l in labels)} anchor row(s)), "
+           f"{len(fix_rows)} fix row(s), {len(dropped)} dropped")
+if args.dry_run:
+    print(summary)
+    for lb in labels:
+        print(f"  KEEP {lb['id']} [{lb['severity']}/{lb['label_source']}] {lb['file']}:{lb['anchors'][0][0]} ({lb['how']}) — {lb['title']}")
+    for d in dropped:
+        print(f"  DROP {d}")
+    sys.exit(0)
+
+if not labels:
+    # the gap goes into corpus.tsv and the reasons into labels/<fx>.dropped.txt;
+    # a previous build of this record fixture is removed (never left stale)
+    shutil.rmtree(fdir, ignore_errors=True)
+    for stale in (os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, f"{fx}.tsv"), os.path.join(MANIFESTS_DIR, f"{fx}.json"),
+                  os.path.join(args.tasks_dir, "review-recall", f"review-{fx}.yaml"),
+                  os.path.join(args.tasks_dir, "audit-recall", f"audit-{fx}.yaml")):
+        if os.path.isfile(stale):
+            os.remove(stale)
+    os.makedirs(LABELS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
+    open(os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, f"{fx}.dropped.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(
+        f"# {fx} sprint-{sprint}: NOT BUILT — no finding became a label\n" + "\n".join(dropped) + ("\n" if dropped else ""))
+    gap = f"# {fx} sprint-{sprint}: no record fixture — no finding met the fix-touches-file rule with a unique anchor ({len(dropped)} finding(s) dropped)"
+    spec = os.path.join(CORPUS, "corpus.tsv")
+    keep = [l for l in open(spec, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if not (l.startswith(fx + "\t") or l.startswith(f"# {fx} "))]
+    open(spec, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(keep + [gap]) + "\n")
+    freeze()
+    print(summary + " — NOT BUILT (gap recorded in corpus.tsv)")
+    sys.exit(0)
+
+shutil.rmtree(fdir, ignore_errors=True)
+os.makedirs(fdir)
+for st, old, new in changes:
+    if st != "A":
+        b = show(base, old)
+        if b is not None:
+            bp = os.path.join(fdir, "base", old); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(bp), exist_ok=True); open(bp, "wb").write(redact(b))
+    if st != "D":
+        h = show(head, new)
+        if h is not None:
+            hp = os.path.join(fdir, "head", new); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(hp), exist_ok=True); open(hp, "wb").write(redact(h))
+open(os.path.join(fdir, "head.diff"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(diff_text)
+open(os.path.join(fdir, "PR.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pr_md)
+tmpl = os.path.join(CORPUS, "pr-01")
+for name in ("REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md", "AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"):
+    shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(tmpl, name), os.path.join(fdir, name))
+open(fy, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(
+    f'name: {fx}\nversion: "1.0.0"\nlanguage: mixed\nruntime: none\ndependency_strategy: none\n'
+    f'description: "record fixture: sprint-{sprint} round-1 state (cycle-129 FR-2); labels live in the hidden labels/ and manifests/ dirs"\n'
+    f'difficulty: advanced\ndomain: framework\ndeprecated: false\n'
+    f'sprint: {sprint}\nbase_commit: "{base}"\nhead_commit: "{head}"\nfix_commit: "{fixc}"\n'
+    f'record_ref: "{record_ref}"\nfeedback_files:\n' + "".join(f'  - "{p}"\n' for p in fb_paths))
+os.makedirs(LABELS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
+open(os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, f"{fx}.tsv"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(tsv) + "\n")
+open(os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, f"{fx}.dropped.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(
+    f"# {fx} sprint-{sprint}: findings that did not become labels\n"
+    + (f"# {REDACTED[0]} secret-shaped test string(s) redacted as REDACTED-TEST-SECRET in base/, head/ and head.diff "
+       "(verbatim copies of tracked test fixtures; line numbers unchanged)\n" if REDACTED[0] else "")
+    + "\n".join(dropped) + ("\n" if dropped else ""))
+
+# no-secrets over everything written (the fixture dir, then the hidden label files)
+def scan(d):
+    p = subprocess.run(["bash", NO_SECRETS, d], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    return p.returncode == 0, p.stdout.strip()
+ok, msg = scan(fdir)
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+    for n in (f"{fx}.tsv", f"{fx}.dropped.txt"):
+        shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, n), os.path.join(td, n))
+    ok2, msg2 = scan(td)
+if not (ok and ok2):
+    shutil.rmtree(fdir, ignore_errors=True)
+    for n in (f"{fx}.tsv", f"{fx}.dropped.txt"):
+        try: os.remove(os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, n))
+        except FileNotFoundError: pass
+    fail(f"{fx}: no-secrets.sh failed; nothing kept: {msg if not ok else msg2}")
+
+man = build_manifest(fx)
+
+# tasks (one per suite), mirroring the pr-01 tasks
+planted = len(man["defects"])
+for suite, kind, skill, art, verb in (("review-recall", "review", "reviewing-code", "review.md", "review recall on"),
+                                      ("audit-recall", "audit", "auditing-security", "audit.md", "audit planted-defect detection on")):
+    instr = "REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md" if kind == "review" else "AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
+    tdir = os.path.join(args.tasks_dir, suite); os.makedirs(tdir, exist_ok=True)
+    open(os.path.join(tdir, f"{kind}-{fx}.yaml"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(
+        f'id: {kind}-{fx}\nschema_version: 1\nskill: {skill}\ncategory: skill-quality\nfixture: review-prs/{fx}\n'
+        f'description: "{verb} record fixture {fx} (sprint-{sprint} round 1; {planted} label(s); hidden manifest)"\n'
+        f'prompt: "Read {instr} in this directory and carry it out."\nagent:\n  skill: {skill}\n  artifacts: [{art}]\n'
+        # record PRs carry 66-383 KB diffs (pr-01 … pr-08: ~7 KB): an hour, not 25 min
+        f'trials: 3\ntimeout:\n  per_trial: 3600\n  per_grader: 60\ngraders:\n  - type: code\n    script: recall-vs-defects.sh\n'
+        f'    args: ["{fx}", "{art}"]\n    weight: 1.0\n  - type: code\n    script: verdict-consistency.sh\n'
+        f'    args: ["{art}", "{kind}"]\n    weight: 0.5\ndifficulty: advanced\ntags: ["cycle-129", "fr-2", "{suite}", "record"]\n')
+
+spec = os.path.join(CORPUS, "corpus.tsv")
+keep = [l for l in open(spec, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if not (l.startswith(fx + "\t") or l.startswith(f"# {fx} "))]
+keep.append("\t".join([fx, "record", head[:8], f"labels/{fx}.tsv", "-", "-", "-", "-"]))
+open(spec, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(keep) + "\n")
+n = freeze()
+print(summary + f"; SHA256SUMS {n} files")
+PY

+  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by

index 00000000..f504611e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.1)
+#
+# execute-agent.sh applies a control arm's toggles to the sandbox copy only.
+# Every assertion here reads the sandbox as the EXECUTOR saw it: the CLI stub
+# snapshots CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .loa.config.yaml and the appended system
+# prompt at the moment it starts (STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR), after every
+# materialisation step. The arm ids and toggles come from the real suite
+# files; the prompt tree is a synthetic fixture so later prose edits to the
+# live kernel cannot change what this test proves.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+  EXEC="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/execute-agent.sh"
+  REVIEW_SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/review-recall.yaml"
+  AUDIT_SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/audit-recall.yaml"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/at.XXXXXX")"
+  WS="$T/ws"; SNAP="$T/snap"
+  mkdir -p "$WS"
+  ( cd "$WS" && git init -q && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m init )
+  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub.sh"
+  export EVAL_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
+  export STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR="$SNAP"
+  unset LOA_EVAL_ARM LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT EVAL_EFFORT
+
+  # --- synthetic prompt tree (the shape of 864069f2) ---
+  PT="$T/tree"
+  mkdir -p "$PT/.claude/loa" "$PT/.claude/rules" "$PT/.claude/data" \
+    "$PT/.claude/skills/reviewing-code" "$PT/.claude/skills/auditing-security"
+  printf '%s\n' "# Loa Framework Instructions" "" "## Three-Zone Model" "" "zones" "" \
+    "## Karpathy Principles" "" "Every code-touching turn." "" "1. **Think before coding** — state assumptions." "" \
+    "## Process Compliance" "" "rules" > "$PT/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  echo "# Git Stash Safety" > "$PT/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md"
+  echo "# Skill Frontmatter Invariants" > "$PT/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md"
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "paths:" '  - "grimoires/**"' "---" "# zone state" > "$PT/.claude/rules/zone-state.md"
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "---" "# Review" "Review the diff." > "$PT/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: auditing-security" "---" "# Audit" "" "### Coverage" "" \
+    "Report every finding you actually observe." "" \
+    "Confirm the review's demotions independently: for each high the review trailer counts under" \
+    "\`excluded\`, either confirm it or tally it as a finding of your own." "" \
+    "## Phase 2.5: Severity Tally" "" "Count every finding." > "$PT/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+  printf '%s\n' "flatline_protocol:" "  code_review:" "    enabled: true" "  security_audit:" "    enabled: true" > "$PT/.loa.config.yaml"
+  ( cd "$PT" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m tree )
+  export EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$PT"
+
+  for s in reviewing-code auditing-security; do
+    cat > "$T/task-$s.yaml" <<YAML
+id: at-$s
+schema_version: 1
+skill: $s
+category: skill-quality
+fixture: hello-world-ts
+description: "arm toggle task"
+prompt: "Read the instructions and carry them out."
+agent:
+  skill: $s
+  artifacts: [review.md]
+graders:
+  - type: code
+    script: file-exists.sh
+    args: ["review.md"]
+YAML
+  done
+}
+
+teardown() {
+  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
+  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+run_arm() {  # run_arm <arm> <suite-file> <skill>
+  LOA_EVAL_ARM="$1" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$2" run "$EXEC" --task-yaml "$T/task-$3.yaml" --workspace "$WS"
+}
+
+@test "AT-1 both suites declare the canonical arm ids and the pre-registered threshold block" {
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.ab.arms[].id] | join(",")' "$REVIEW_SUITE")" = "baseline,no_companion,no_karpathy,no_rule_files" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.ab.arms[].id] | join(",")' "$AUDIT_SUITE")" = "baseline,no_audit_delta" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.ab.arms[] | select(.id=="no_companion") | .informational' "$REVIEW_SUITE")" = "true" ]
+  yq -r '.ab.arms[] | select(.id=="no_karpathy") | .description' "$REVIEW_SUITE" | grep -q 'kernel block only'
+  for s in "$REVIEW_SUITE" "$AUDIT_SUITE"; do
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.trials_required' "$s")" = "3" ]
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.coverage_required' "$s")" = "full" ]
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.mean_recall_max_drop' "$s")" = "0.10" ]
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.min_trial_recall_max_drop' "$s")" = "0.15" ]
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.refuted_share_max_rise' "$s")" = "0.10" ]
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.bootstrap | [.method, .level, .resample, .iterations] | join(",")' "$s")" = "percentile,0.90,fixtures,2000" ]
+    # the existing freshness keys are untouched
+    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.corpus_manifest' "$s")" = "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS" ]
+  done
+}
+
+@test "AT-2 baseline: every toggled surface is present at executor start and the row records the arm" {
+  run_arm baseline "$REVIEW_SUITE" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$SNAP/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  [ -f "$SNAP/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]
+  [ -f "$SNAP/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml")" = "null" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.arm' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "baseline" ]
+  [ "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "{}" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "$(git -C "$PT" rev-parse HEAD)" ]
+}
+
+@test "AT-3 audit baseline: the delta paragraph is in the sandbox SKILL.md and the system prompt" {
+  run_arm baseline "$AUDIT_SUITE" auditing-security
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q "Confirm the review's demotions independently" "$SNAP/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+  grep -q "Confirm the review's demotions independently" "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
+}
+
+@test "AT-4 no_rule_files: the two rule files are absent at executor start; other rules stay; the source tree is untouched" {
+  run_arm no_rule_files "$REVIEW_SUITE" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ ! -e "$SNAP/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]
+  [ ! -e "$SNAP/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md" ]
+  [ -f "$SNAP/.claude/rules/zone-state.md" ]
+  [ -f "$PT/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]
+  [ -z "$(git -C "$PT" status --porcelain)" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.arm' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "no_rule_files" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.rule_files' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+@test "AT-5 no_karpathy: the section is gone at executor start, its neighbours stay, a sandbox constraints.json loses its Karpathy rows" {
+  mkdir -p "$WS/.claude/data"
+  printf '%s\n' '{"version":1,"constraints":[{"id":"C-KARPATHY-1","text":"Karpathy surgical"},{"id":"C-PROC-001","text":"implement only"}]}' \
+    > "$WS/.claude/data/constraints.json"
+  run_arm no_karpathy "$REVIEW_SUITE" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  ! grep -q 'Karpathy' "$SNAP/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  ! grep -q 'Think before coding' "$SNAP/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  grep -q '^## Three-Zone Model' "$SNAP/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  grep -q '^## Process Compliance' "$SNAP/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  [ "$(jq -r '[.constraints[].id] | join(",")' "$SNAP/.claude/data/constraints.json")" = "C-PROC-001" ]
+  grep -q 'Karpathy' "$PT/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+}
+
+@test "AT-6 no_companion: companion_voice is false in the sandbox config at executor start; the source config is untouched" {
+  run_arm no_companion "$REVIEW_SUITE" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml")" = "false" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice' "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml")" = "false" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled' "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml")" = "true" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$PT/.loa.config.yaml")" = "null" ]
+}
+
+@test "AT-7 no_audit_delta: the delta paragraph is gone from the sandbox SKILL.md and the system prompt; the removed text is kept" {
+  run_arm no_audit_delta "$AUDIT_SUITE" auditing-security
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  ! grep -q "demotions independently" "$SNAP/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+  ! grep -q "demotions independently" "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
+  grep -q 'Report every finding you actually observe' "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
+  grep -q '^## Phase 2.5' "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
+  grep -q "Confirm the review's demotions independently" "$WS/.eval/arm-removed.txt"
+  grep -q "demotions independently" "$PT/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+}
+
+@test "AT-8 the literal 'look for what the review did not' paragraph wins when present" {
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: auditing-security" "---" "# Audit" "" \
+    "Read the review first, then look for what the review did not." "" \
+    "Confirm the review's demotions independently." > "$PT/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+  run_arm no_audit_delta "$AUDIT_SUITE" auditing-security
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  ! grep -q 'look for what the review did not' "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
+  grep -q 'demotions independently' "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
+}
+
+@test "AT-9 an arm that cannot take effect fails the trial before the executor starts (exit 2, no CLI call)" {
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: auditing-security" "---" "# Audit" "no delta here" > "$PT/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/tests/arms-report.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
+#
+# report.sh --arms over a fixture results tree (the layout run-arms.sh
+# writes): the pre-registered verdicts, the bootstrap interval, refuted share,
+# missed labels, the refusal while STATUS.json is not complete and the
+# --partial header. Thresholds come from the real review-recall suite.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+  REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/report.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
+  R="$T/arms"; S="$R/review-recall"; B="$S/b1"
+  mkdir -p "$B"
+  jq -n '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", batch:"b1", dry_run:false, source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457",
+          model_id:"claude-fable-5-1", arms:["baseline","no_companion","no_karpathy","no_rule_files"], fixtures:["pr-01","pr-02","pr-03"], trials:3}' \
+    > "$B/MANIFEST.json"
+  status_file complete
+}
+
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+status_file() {  # status_file <state>
+  jq -n --arg s "$1" '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", state:$s, batches:[{batch:"b1", state:$s}],
+                       source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457", model_id:"claude-fable-5-1"}' > "$S/STATUS.json"
+}
+
+# row <arm> <fixture> <trial> <recall> <missed-csv> [<cited> <refuted> <model> <source>]
+row() {
+  local arm="$1" fx="$2" t="$3" rc="$4" missed="$5" cited="${6:-4}" ref="${7:-1}"
+  local model="${8:-claude-fable-5-1}" src="${9:-864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457}"
+  mkdir -p "$B/$arm"
+  jq -cn --arg arm "$arm" --arg fx "$fx" --argjson t "$t" --argjson rc "$rc" --arg missed "$missed" \
+    --argjson cited "$cited" --argjson ref "$ref" --arg model "$model" --arg src "$src" \
+    '{status:"completed", arm:$arm, fixture:$fx, task_id:("review-" + $fx), trial:$t, model_id:$model, source_commit:$src,
+      executor:{model_id:$model, usage:{input_tokens:100, cache_read_input_tokens:900, output_tokens:0, cache_creation_input_tokens:0}},
+      graders:[{name:"recall-vs-defects.sh", details:{recall:$rc, planted:3,
+        detected:[], missed:($missed | split(",") | map(select(length > 0))),
+        findings_cited:$cited, findings_refuted:$ref}}]}' >> "$B/$arm/results.jsonl"
+}
+
+full_arm() {  # full_arm <arm> <recall> [<missed>] [<refuted>]
+  local fx t
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row "$1" "$fx" "$t" "$2" "${3:-}" 4 "${4:-1}"; done; done
+}
+
+@test "AR-1 complete run: equal recall reads no recall loss, a large drop reads recall loss, the informational arm says so" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1
+  full_arm no_karpathy 0.3333 "L2,L3" 1
+  full_arm no_companion 1
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md" --date 2026-10-14
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*no recall loss\*\*'
+  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'
+  grep -E '^\| `no_companion` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q 'informational: yield only'
+  grep -E '^\| `baseline` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '(reference)'
+  # the interval of the drop and the missed labels are printed
+  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\[0.667, 0.667\]'
+  grep -q 'no_karpathy`: pr-01:L2 (3/3)' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -q '^# Control-arm report — 2026-10-14' "$T/r.md"
+  ! grep -q 'PARTIAL REPORT' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-2 a refuted-share rise beyond the threshold is a recall loss even with equal recall" {
+  full_arm baseline 1 "" 0
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1 "" 3
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'
+  grep -q 'refuted share 0.750 > baseline 0.000' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-3 a missing trial or fixture is inconclusive; model or source skew is inconclusive" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02; do for t in 1 2 3; do row no_rule_files "$fx" "$t" 1 ""; done; done
+  row no_rule_files pr-03 1 1 ""
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row no_karpathy "$fx" "$t" 1 "" 4 1 claude-opus-5-5; done; done
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row no_companion "$fx" "$t" 1 "" 4 1 claude-fable-5-1 ffd25258; done; done
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  grep -q 'coverage: pr-03 1/3' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  grep -q 'model skew' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -q 'source skew' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-4 a rule violation within the baseline's own trial-to-trial spread names no change (inconclusive)" {
+  # baseline trial means 1.0, 0.6, 1.0 (spread 0.4); the arm sits 0.2 lower on every fixture
+  local fx
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do row baseline "$fx" 1 1 ""; row baseline "$fx" 2 0.6 ""; row baseline "$fx" 3 1 ""; done
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do row no_rule_files "$fx" 1 0.8 ""; row no_rule_files "$fx" 2 0.4 ""; row no_rule_files "$fx" 3 0.8 ""; done
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  grep -q 'no change can be named' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-5 STATUS.json not complete: refused (exit 1); --partial writes, says so, and every verdict is inconclusive" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1
+  status_file running
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  grep -q "not 'complete'" <<<"$output"
+  [ ! -e "$T/r.md" ]
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md" --partial
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q 'PARTIAL REPORT' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  ! grep -q '\*\*no recall loss\*\*' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-7 a safeguard-refusal fallback to another model is skew: the arm is inconclusive and the fallback is named" {
